filter: is_primary_data == True and disease == 'normal' and tissue_type == 'tissue'

supplement.reason: Specific granule labels exist only in the dissection files

rules.unit: One adult donor x one named Vital or Protected cell population, UMI counts
rules.signal: >= 1% of a donor's cells and >= 10 cells carry >= 2 molecules.
rules.replication: The signal in >= 2 independent studies of the same organ. Donors of one study share its libraries and reference.
rules.single_study: Without replication, a signal counts only when >= 5% of a donor's cells carry multiple molecules. It can reach review, never Unsafe.
rules.single_molecules: Cells with one molecule never change a category. A mis-assigned read from a paralog, pseudogene or overlapping gene produces exactly this pattern.
rules.mapping_risk: Shared transcript sequence with another locus, or an exon inside another same-strand gene. A flagged gene cannot be established from counts.
rules.confirmation: Bulk RNA >= 1 native TPM in the same organ in both the HPA and GTEx sample sets. Accepted protein evidence is assessed by its own rules.
rules.established: Replicated signal, no mapping risk, and confirmation.
rules.unresolved: A replicated signal lacking a clean mapping or confirmation, or a frequent signal from one study.

consequences.below_screen: No finding. Not a demonstration of absence or safety.
consequences.unassessed: Recorded as unmeasured; never treated as negative.

rules.release: Read-level review settles an unresolved signal: unique alignment and exonic or splice-spanning reads establish it; their absence dismisses it with the evidence.
rules.interpretation: Detection frequency measures captured RNA, not the fraction of cells producing protein. No cutoff is a calibrated toxicity threshold.

mapping_risk.strand: sense k-mers only; the assays are stranded
limitations: Exact shared k-mers; diverged or unannotated paralogous sequence is not found
A flag marks a possible confounder, not a demonstrated mis-assignment
An unflagged gene can still collect intronic or genomic-DNA reads

panel.scope: adult, known donor, UMI protocol, primary normal tissue
panel.excluded_cell_types: macrophage|monocyte|microglia|\bt cell|\bb cell|\bnk cell|natural killer|lymphocyte|leukocyte|dendritic|mast cell|neutrophil|plasma cell|myeloid|erythro|platelet|hematopoietic|immune|fibroblast|mesenchymal|stromal|adipocyte|neuroblast|precursor|progenitor|radial glia|immature|fetal|embryonic|primitive|cycling|proliferating|germinal|ganglionic eminence|malignant|neoplastic

limitations: A gene-count matrix cannot check alignment, strand or exonic support; the mapping-risk flags are reference properties, not read-level checks
No empty-droplet or ambient-RNA correction is applied to the pinned counts
Donor overlap across collections has not been reviewed
Proteins that were Unsafe for another reason were not extracted
